errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите, които са библиометрични анализи
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis categories are explicitly grouped into three types: "справки" (references), "библиометрични анализи" (bibliometric analyses), and "друго" (other). Stating that all categories are bibliometric analyses is an over-generalization.
The vertical axis is not labeled. The label "справки" is a group label on the horizontal axis for the first two bars.
The label for the bar with the highest value (8) is "друго (посочете какво)". The generated description provides a completely incorrect and nonsensical label "групо (когато)".
The correct label for the first bar is "цитатни справки". The generated description contains a typo.
The correct label is "по изследователски полета" (plural). The description uses the singular form "поле".
The description fails to mention the structural grouping of the categories on the x-axis into three distinct sections labeled "справки", "библиометрични анализи", and "друго".
